labels.name: bug
labels.description: Confirmed bug: the claimed behavior reproduces and is backed up by the code

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: A well-reasoned proposal for an improvement or new functionality

labels.name: question
labels.description: A genuine question about using or understanding the project, not a bug report

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Filed in good faith, but the claimed problem is not confirmed by the code or is expected behavior

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Not enough data to reach a conclusion: missing reproduction steps, version, logs or a file

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: Looks like an already-existing issue or pull request

labels.name: good-pr
labels.description: A solid PR: clear diff, solves the stated problem, follows the repo's conventions

labels.name: needs-work
labels.description: A legitimate PR, but the diff has issues: style, bugs, missing tests

labels.name: trash
labels.description: Junk: spam, ads, abuse, or no real content
